versions.changelog:
offer-rain 0.1.1

- 补全本Skill需要的脚本文件

Initial release of offer-rain skill.

- Provides guided steps for sending resume emails via 163.com SMTP, with detailed user configuration.
- Step-by-step email info extraction from job descriptions, with required user confirmation.
- Enforces field-by-field self-check referencing job posting text before allowing sending.
- Supports both single and batch job application submissions, managing each mail configuration separately.
- Enables user info memorization for faster future applications and easy config edits.
